name: Tax Voucher
definition: Statement showing the amount or value of a distribution and either the tax credit to which the recipient is entitled in respect of that distribution; or the amount of tax deducted from the distribution.

RequestedTaxationRate.name: Requested Taxation Rate
RequestedTaxationRate.definition: Requested tax rate in case of breakdown of tax rate, for example, used for adjustment of tax rate. This is the new requested applicable rate.

CreditRate.name: Credit Rate
CreditRate.definition: Applicable tax rate on the tax credit amount.

SundryOrOtherAmount.name: Sundry Or Other Amount
SundryOrOtherAmount.definition: Amount of money related to taxable income that cannot be categorised.

CreditAmount.name: Credit Amount
CreditAmount.definition: Amount of money per equity allocated as the result of a tax credit.

CashAmountBroughtForward.name: Cash Amount Brought Forward
CashAmountBroughtForward.definition: Cash amount retained from previous dividend or interest payment.

CashAmountCarriedForward.name: Cash Amount Carried Forward
CashAmountCarriedForward.definition: Cash amount carried forward to next dividend or interest payment.

NotionalTaxAmount.name: Notional Tax Amount
NotionalTaxAmount.definition: Tax on the amount of cash that would have been paid when new securities are issued in lieu of a cash dividend.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the tax voucher.

BargainDate.name: Bargain Date
BargainDate.definition: Date on which DRIP purchase completed.

BargainSettlementDate.name: Bargain Settlement Date
BargainSettlementDate.definition: Settlement date of the DRIP purchase transaction.

AllotedSharesCost.name: Alloted Shares Cost
AllotedSharesCost.definition: Total cash amount required to purchase shares allotted.

RelatedSecurityTax.name: Related Security Tax
RelatedSecurityTax.definition: Specifies tax elements on the security which is involved in the corporate event.

Distribution.name: Distribution
Distribution.definition: Corporate action distribution process for which tax voucher information is provided.

ScripDividendReinvestmentPricePerShare.name: Scrip Dividend Reinvestment Price Per Share
ScripDividendReinvestmentPricePerShare.definition: Cost per share of new shares allotted.

ForeignExchangeTransaction.name: Foreign Exchange Transaction
ForeignExchangeTransaction.definition: Provides information about the foreign exchange transaction.
